summary: Full-history secret scan (22-26 Task 1, AC-35, D-16 immediate tier): the git-mode-proven betterleaks 1.10.0 three-pass scan of all 1053 commits (every ref and every reflog entry, 5 stashes) reported 50 hits: 10 known-public Hardhat #0 (AUD-SECRET-002, not escalated), 36 public-address (AUD-SECRET-001, not escalated) and 4 non-public hits, all in .planning/ documents: (1) AUD-SECRET-004, one generic-api-key hit on .planning/intel/.last-refresh.json whose flagged value is the SHA-256 content hash of .planning/intel/api-map.json (5 of 5 values in that map are file hashes); (2) AUD-SECRET-005, three generic-credential-uri hits in the Phase 20 code-review documents, each the host-spoofing test string http://127.0.0.1:8080@<attacker-example host>. A read-only diagnosis (values never printed; booleans only) found no credential, key, token or session among them. No hit of any kind in scripts/ or contracts/, and no non-public hit in src/, test/ or any config. Phase 22 neither rotates keys nor rewrites history (NAC-13, P11); git history still contains these strings; the operator decides how to label them.

resolution.statement: Per the operator ruling "not secrets", AUD-SECRET-004 (the SHA-256 content hash of .planning/intel/api-map.json in .planning/intel/.last-refresh.json) and AUD-SECRET-005 (the http://127.0.0.1:8080@<host> URL-userinfo host-spoofing test string in the Phase 20 review documents) are closed as NOT-A-BUG. secret_class stays non-public on both, because that is the mechanical scanner classification the escalation was raised on; the operator ruling is the authority for the closure. No key was rotated, git history was not rewritten, no value was printed, logged or committed. AUD-SECRET-001 keeps its recorded coverage limit (a bare 64-hex value with no key-like word near it is not flagged).
